Native-safety: the five storage helpers read `globalThis.localStorage` (typed WebLikeStorage with getItem/setItem/removeItem) following the existing src/visual-parity/visualParityMode.ts idiom. Under the react-native-web build this is the real window.localStorage (full web parity); under Hermes/native it is undefined, so readers return null and writers no-op exactly like the source's `typeof window === 'undefined'` branch — column prefs degrade to in-memory-only without throwing. No DOM, browser HTML, Recharts, Leaflet, react-leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported (the module has zero external imports).
